description.value: At 11th level, a cleric knows how to take best advantage of tactical opportunities. Whenever he is flanking or makes an attack of opportunity, he may add his Charisma bonus (if any) as a bonus on the attack roll. In addition, once per day as a swift action, he may add his Charisma modifier as a bonus on any single d20 roll made as part of a readied action. He can use this ability one additional time per day for every three cleric levels after 11th.
